stories.title: Utah women business leaders honored for building companies and opening doors
stories.summary: Minky Couture's Sandi Sumner Hendry receives the ATHENA Leadership Award. Six others are named Pathfinders at the chamber's 50th annual conference.

stories.title: SUU adjunct professor breaks world record, brings attention to mitochondrial research
stories.summary: Tyler LeBaron, an exercise physiology professor and molecular scientist, broke the world record for the fastest half marathon while carrying a 40-pound rucksack at the Snow Canyon Half Marathon.

stories.title: California sues OpenAI, seeking court-ordered changes after the Hugging Face hack
stories.summary: California's attorney general filed a lawsuit against OpenAI in an effort to force it to change its business practices over a cybersecurity incident in which its AI system hacked into another company on its own.

stories.title: West Bountiful man to serve 20 days jail for alleged sexual battery of child
stories.summary: A Davis County man accused of inappropriately touching a young girl was sentenced to less than a month in jail.

stories.title: Hotel bookings surged amid nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: Some hotels near airports reported full occupancy within minutes of Friday's ground stop announcement from the FAA.

stories.title: Man accused for second time in 5 months of sex offenses against teens
stories.summary: A registered sex offender accused of inappropriately touching a teen girl in June is now accused of assaulting a second teen.

stories.title: Rare North Atlantic right whale population drops, alarming scientists
stories.summary: The population of one of the world's rarest whales has fallen after trending upward in recent years, worrying scientists who fear the animal could still be at risk of extinction.

stories.title: How this Spanish artist made her colorful Avenues home worth touring, even after her death
stories.summary: The daughter of a late Salt Lake City artist hopes to preserve her mother's vibrant and art-filled home by starting a nonprofit for the arts.

stories.title: Teen hospitalized after stabbing at Ogden Preparatory Academy
stories.summary: A teenage boy is in the hospital after being stabbed by a fellow student at school Monday afternoon.

stories.title: United Airlines says it resolved a technology issue that affected departing flights
stories.summary: United Airlines said Monday that it had resolved a technology issue that delayed departing flights, just days after a malfunction in the Federal Aviation Administration's network prompted a nationwide ground stop.

stories.title: Mix up the menu with a few fun Thanksgiving traditions that go beyond the food
stories.summary: Kate Mulford said every family should have at least one Thanksgiving tradition beyond what's on your plate.

stories.title: Driver accused of critically injuring man in Spanish Fork crosswalk is charged
stories.summary: A woman who police say hit a man in a crosswalk in Spanish Fork but continued to drive has been charged.
